text: I can no longer do a weld i could do before. tap in and look at my verts selected
resolution: The selected seam vertices were valid; the failure was introduced by the authored-boundary weld guard. After a cut, the live displayed mesh had 544 triangles while source-owned face-group rows still represented 542, and the guard incorrectly rejected that normal divergence. It now snapshots the current displayed face-group mapping, matching the authority used by the editor's other topology transactions, while retaining the malformed-face protection. The mesh-edit suite passes 99/99 and the editor ships successfully in ReleaseFast.
